# Loading data
```{r}
# This is output from the EP exploration nb
enhancer_transcript_df <- readRDS(file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "by_GRB_list_enh_trans_df.rds"))
loci_in_GRB <- readRDS(file = file.path(project_dir, processed_dir, "loci_in_GRBs.gr.rds"))
```


```{r}
enhancer_transcript_gr <- grangesFromDataframe(enhancer_transcript_df, enh, keep_metadata = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Overlapping enhancers with LD blocks
loci_enh_op <- join_overlap_left(loci_in_GRB, enhancer_transcript_gr)
loci_enh_op <- as.data.frame(mcols(loci_enh_op))

loci_enh_op
```


```{r}
temp <- loci_enh_op %>%
  filter(!is.na(enh)) %>%
  #signf long range
  filter(emp < 0.001 & enh_trans_range > 100000)

as.data.frame(table(temp$MAPPED_TRAIT)) %>% arrange(desc(Freq))

filter(temp, symbol == GRB_GENES) %>%
  pull(MAPPED_TRAIT) %>%
  table() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  arrange(desc(Freq))


filter(temp, symbol == GWAS_GENES) %>%
  pull(MAPPED_TRAIT) %>%
  table() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  arrange(desc(Freq))

temp <- loci_enh_op %>%
  filter(!is.na(enh)) %>%
  #signf long range
  filter(emp < 0.001)

temp %>%
  # filter(MAPPED_TRAIT == "bitter non-alcoholic beverage consumption measurement") %>%
  select(SNPS, enh, emp, MAPPED_TRAIT, enh_trans_range, symbol, ensembl, GWAS_GENES) %>%
  unique() %>%
  group_by(MAPPED_TRAIT) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(enh_trans_range),
            count = n(),
            genes_symbol = paste0(unique(symbol), collapse = ", "),
            genes_ensembl = paste0(unique(ensembl), collapse = ", "),
            GWAS_sum = paste0(unique(GWAS_GENES), collapse = ", "),
            jaccard = ProportionOfGenesShared(symbol, str_split(GWAS_sum, pattern = ", ",simplify = TRUE)[1,])) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  View()


temp %>%
  select(SNPS, enh, emp, MAPPED_TRAIT, enh_trans_range) %>%
  unique() %>%
  group_by(MAPPED_TRAIT) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  View()
```


```{r}
data_ <- enhancer_transcript_df %>%
  select(grb, transcript, enh_num_4gene) %>%
  unique()

temp <-
  data_ %>%
  group_by(grb) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(enh_num_4gene))


hist(temp$mean, breaks = 40)

ggplot(data_, aes(x=grb, y=enh_num_4gene)) +
  geom_point()
```
